title: Table Candidates
description: HTML generations of a cropped table by a vision-language model: one greedy and zero or more seeded samples.

text.description: Generated text with code fences removed; the caller extracts the <table>.

finish.description: Why generation stopped ('length' means the table was cut at the token limit).

seed.description: Sampling seed; absent for the greedy generation.

samples.description: Seeded generations at the requested temperature.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling threshold of the samples.

use_hints.description: Whether the prompt showed the providers' tables.

header_cells.description: Tag the prompt asked for in header cells.

model.description: Model identifier the server answered with.
